notes:
Summary: DevStream is building an opinionated VS Code copilot for distributed engineering teams. Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions + robust inline suggestions with predictable per-seat costs.

Key requirements / quotes: 
- "We need completions to feel instant in the editor; spikes >500ms break flow" — CTO (R. Morales).
- Support model/version pinning per-extension-version (must be able to pin stable model for GA and automatically fallback to smaller quantized variant if Dedicated capacity is constrained).
- Auth: org SSO (SAML) + optional per-seat API key provisioning for enterprise customers; want single-tenant tokening for auditability.
- Rate limits: need predictable per-user throughput (tokens/min) and a throttling model that integrates with extension (able to show "quota remaining" in UI). Team prefers per-seat quotas over global token buckets.
- Latency targets: POC goal = 95th percentile first-byte < 200ms for typical dev machines on NA regions; target avg token RTT 80-120ms on warm sessions.
- Cost sensitivity: aggressive on cost per active dev — target <$0.50/dev/day for common completion workload. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + kv cache tuning).
- Offline/edge behavior: graceful degradation when network poor — local prefix caching + deterministic fallback to on-device heuristics.

POC plan: 2-week internal POC with 20 engineers (macOS + Windows), integrate Redwood SDK into VS Code extension, measure latency, token utilization, and UX for streaming partial tokens. POC acceptance criteria: streaming latency under threshold, model pinning works end-to-end, SSO provisioning automated.

Security / legal notes: provided internal security questionnaire; legal asked for DPA + standard DP processing terms; data residency must be US-only for initial contract. SOC2 evidence requested. KMS integration required for private key material.

Action items captured: 
- Redwood to send Dedicated sizing worksheet and draft DPA (Marcus)
- DevStream to share dev concurrency metrics and sample telemetry (eng-lead@devstream.ai)
- Schedule proof-of-concept kickoff week starting 2025-03-17
